title: Power Rankings: Suns back in swing of things; Wade-less Heat tumble
heading: 2006-07 Power Rankings: Week 17
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: The big winners at the deadline? It might have been those pesky Mavs, who began the week on a 32-2 run and saw none of their nearest rivals make an impact trade.
rankings.summaryText: The big winners at the deadline? It might have been those pesky Mavs, who began the week on a 32-2 run and saw none of their nearest rivals make an impact trade.

rankings.summaryHtml: Nash returns, Suns post a 4-0 week and Charles Barkley annoys his former employers with his TV criticism. Sounds like things are getting back to normal in the desert.
rankings.summaryText: Nash returns, Suns post a 4-0 week and Charles Barkley annoys his former employers with his TV criticism. Sounds like things are getting back to normal in the desert.

rankings.summaryHtml: Are we seeing Spurs' best ball of the season? The team at the center of a rankings storm is riding its longest win streak since a seven-gamer this time last season.
rankings.summaryText: Are we seeing Spurs' best ball of the season? The team at the center of a rankings storm is riding its longest win streak since a seven-gamer this time last season.

rankings.summaryHtml: AK-47 and Okur limp off just as Boozer comes back, but this Jazz -- contrary to what we all said coming into the season -- doesn't have to be at full strength to win.
rankings.summaryText: AK-47 and Okur limp off just as Boozer comes back, but this Jazz -- contrary to what we all said coming into the season -- doesn't have to be at full strength to win.

rankings.summaryHtml: Pistons are the East's deadline winners. None of their rivals swung a significant deal, either, and snatching up Webber was better than any trade they could've made.
rankings.summaryText: Pistons are the East's deadline winners. None of their rivals swung a significant deal, either, and snatching up Webber was better than any trade they could've made.

rankings.summaryHtml: Last season, Rockets were riddled with injuries and won 34 games. This season, with Yao and T-Mac together in only 20 games, Rockets have topped that total already.
rankings.summaryText: Last season, Rockets were riddled with injuries and won 34 games. This season, with Yao and T-Mac together in only 20 games, Rockets have topped that total already.

rankings.summaryHtml: You dare to dispute Raps' top-10 status? At 18-7, Toronto took the league's third-best record in 2007 into this week, behind only Mavs (22-2) and Suns (22-5).
rankings.summaryText: You dare to dispute Raps' top-10 status? At 18-7, Toronto took the league's third-best record in 2007 into this week, behind only Mavs (22-2) and Suns (22-5).

rankings.summaryHtml: The Florida teams would be grateful, at this point, just to snag a playoff berth. Wiz, in other words, are a virtual lock to win their division now unless Arenas goes down.
rankings.summaryText: The Florida teams would be grateful, at this point, just to snag a playoff berth. Wiz, in other words, are a virtual lock to win their division now unless Arenas goes down.

rankings.summaryHtml: Bulls are subjected to more trade rumors than anyone this side of KG, so we probably shouldn't be surprised that they've looked sharper and more settled post-deadline.
rankings.summaryText: Bulls are subjected to more trade rumors than anyone this side of KG, so we probably shouldn't be surprised that they've looked sharper and more settled post-deadline.

rankings.summaryHtml: Cavs were crushed that they couldn't swing a Bibby deal. Two defeats since the deadline passed should tell you why they were trying so hard to get one done.
rankings.summaryText: Cavs were crushed that they couldn't swing a Bibby deal. Two defeats since the deadline passed should tell you why they were trying so hard to get one done.

rankings.summaryHtml: At 23-11, Kobe was an MVP candidate and the Zenmeister was COY material. But Lakers' recent slide reached 7-14 before weekend wins over Celts and Warriors.
rankings.summaryText: At 23-11, Kobe was an MVP candidate and the Zenmeister was COY material. But Lakers' recent slide reached 7-14 before weekend wins over Celts and Warriors.

rankings.summaryHtml: If the West is so great, how come only six teams have winning records? I'll tell you who doesn't care: Byron Scott's Hornets, who suddenly find themselves at No. 7.
rankings.summaryText: If the West is so great, how come only six teams have winning records? I'll tell you who doesn't care: Byron Scott's Hornets, who suddenly find themselves at No. 7.

rankings.summaryHtml: If they're unhappy to be stuck in Jersey, it's tough to tell. Since the trade buzzer sounded: Kidd had a triple-double, Carter had a 40-point game and Nets are 2-0.
rankings.summaryText: If they're unhappy to be stuck in Jersey, it's tough to tell. Since the trade buzzer sounded: Kidd had a triple-double, Carter had a 40-point game and Nets are 2-0.

rankings.summaryHtml: A heavy home loss to Artest-less Kings is bad. But this is worse: Indy also lost at home this month to three other sub-.500 West teams: Warriors, Sonics and Nuggets.
rankings.summaryText: A heavy home loss to Artest-less Kings is bad. But this is worse: Indy also lost at home this month to three other sub-.500 West teams: Warriors, Sonics and Nuggets.

rankings.summaryHtml: Only one champion since 1970 -- Chicago after MJ's 1998 retirement -- has failed to reach the playoffs in the following season. But my bet is Heat won't be No. 2.
rankings.summaryText: Only one champion since 1970 -- Chicago after MJ's 1998 retirement -- has failed to reach the playoffs in the following season. But my bet is Heat won't be No. 2.

rankings.summaryHtml: Dwane Casey is smiling somewhere. Even with Sunday's victory over Wiz, Wolves are 6-10 since Casey's dismissal and KG just dropped his first hint about leaving.
rankings.summaryText: Dwane Casey is smiling somewhere. Even with Sunday's victory over Wiz, Wolves are 6-10 since Casey's dismissal and KG just dropped his first hint about leaving.

rankings.summaryHtml: With the trade deadline passing, Maggette rumors are officially on hold. Of course, that also means Clips can no longer use Maggette's situation as a distraction alibi.
rankings.summaryText: With the trade deadline passing, Maggette rumors are officially on hold. Of course, that also means Clips can no longer use Maggette's situation as a distraction alibi.

rankings.summaryHtml: The inability to trade Magloire is the secondary mystery in Blazerland. Mystery No. 1: How do they beat Jazz and Lakers back-to-back, then lose at home to Grizz?
rankings.summaryText: The inability to trade Magloire is the secondary mystery in Blazerland. Mystery No. 1: How do they beat Jazz and Lakers back-to-back, then lose at home to Grizz?

rankings.summaryHtml: It's been a rough year all around for in-season trades. Defensively challenged Nuggets awoke Monday with a 2-7 record when Melo and Iverson are both healthy.
rankings.summaryText: It's been a rough year all around for in-season trades. Defensively challenged Nuggets awoke Monday with a 2-7 record when Melo and Iverson are both healthy.

rankings.summaryHtml: Magic awoke Monday down to No. 9 in the East and suddenly three games under .500. Unless they can repeat last spring's big finish, Hill might be finished as coach.
rankings.summaryText: Magic awoke Monday down to No. 9 in the East and suddenly three games under .500. Unless they can repeat last spring's big finish, Hill might be finished as coach.

rankings.summaryHtml: As Warriors head East for five games, J-Rich says: 'This road trip will make or break the season.' If it's a bad trip? J-Rich adds: 'We might as well hang the playoffs up.'
rankings.summaryText: As Warriors head East for five games, J-Rich says: 'This road trip will make or break the season.' If it's a bad trip? J-Rich adds: 'We might as well hang the playoffs up.'

rankings.summaryHtml: I'm guessing Knicks were rooting for Nets to go ahead and trade Kidd and Carter. After Sunday's triumph, New Jersey has won 20 of the teams' last 24 encounters.
rankings.summaryText: I'm guessing Knicks were rooting for Nets to go ahead and trade Kidd and Carter. After Sunday's triumph, New Jersey has won 20 of the teams' last 24 encounters.

rankings.summaryHtml: A challenge to Mr. Morrison and every other applicable Bobcat: Charlotte is the only team left in the league that has never had a player score 45 points in a game.
rankings.summaryText: A challenge to Mr. Morrison and every other applicable Bobcat: Charlotte is the only team left in the league that has never had a player score 45 points in a game.

rankings.summaryHtml: In the unforgiving Western Conference, these are fatal trends: Kings are 0-5 in overtime games and have racked up 11 losses by five points or fewer.
rankings.summaryText: In the unforgiving Western Conference, these are fatal trends: Kings are 0-5 in overtime games and have racked up 11 losses by five points or fewer.

rankings.summaryHtml: That wacky Chuckster: Barkley lives in PHX and never seems satisfied with Suns, but works in ATL and swore back in November that Hawks would make the playoffs.
rankings.summaryText: That wacky Chuckster: Barkley lives in PHX and never seems satisfied with Suns, but works in ATL and swore back in November that Hawks would make the playoffs.

rankings.summaryHtml: It's official: Seattle will have at least one more season of NBA basketball. Then again, one more season like this one and last season and the locals might not miss Sonics.
rankings.summaryText: It's official: Seattle will have at least one more season of NBA basketball. Then again, one more season like this one and last season and the locals might not miss Sonics.

rankings.summaryHtml: Bucks came out of the break with 19 of their final 29 games at home. It would've been the league's kindest stretch run if Redd's injury hadn't already KO'd them.
rankings.summaryText: Bucks came out of the break with 19 of their final 29 games at home. It would've been the league's kindest stretch run if Redd's injury hadn't already KO'd them.

rankings.summaryHtml: Back-to-back heavy losses to Bobcats and Bucks suggest (to us, anyway) that Sixers finally realized they were winning a little too often for their own (draft-day) good.
rankings.summaryText: Back-to-back heavy losses to Bobcats and Bucks suggest (to us, anyway) that Sixers finally realized they were winning a little too often for their own (draft-day) good.

rankings.summaryHtml: Yikes. Even with Mike Miller going for 45 points in Wednesday's OT loss at Golden State, Grizz are now a frightful 0-17 in the second game of back-to-backs.
rankings.summaryText: Yikes. Even with Mike Miller going for 45 points in Wednesday's OT loss at Golden State, Grizz are now a frightful 0-17 in the second game of back-to-backs.

rankings.summaryHtml: We keep getting e-mails asking why Celts are lower than Grizz. Huh? Pierce might be back, but Celts arrived in Texas at 3-23 in 2007 ... and thus right where they belong.
